comment: Options per host-detected situation id. The host names WHAT is happening; this manual enumerates legitimate responses and when each fits; the model picks. Ids and evidence fields match AgentSituationEngine exactly. Options are alternatives, not a ranking.

entries.title: BASE ATTACKED (ground/mixed)
entries.facts: evidence: visibleEnemyCount/Value, defenderCount/Value, threatVerdict, attackerClass, classCounts, dogRush

options.label: hold
options.play: let defenses and standing orders fire; garrison squad attacks the intruders

options.label: crush-sortie
options.play: attackMove vehicles into the mass — tracked vehicles and the ore truck crush infantry

options.label: anti-armor stand
options.play: rockets+tanks behind defenses; repair buildings DURING the fight (repair costs ~20% of value)

options.label: full recall
options.when: threatVerdict strong OR 2+ critical assets under fire
options.play: reinforce home / move mainArmy back

options.label: mutual raid
options.when: their army is HERE and your army is closer to their base than home
options.play: strike posture=raid on their economy

entries.note: dogRush=true: never panic-recall — any vehicle crushes dogs and dogs cannot damage vehicles; keep own infantry behind defenses/vehicles.

entries.title: ENEMY AIR (sighted or over base)
entries.facts: evidence: visibleEnemyCount/Value, targetType (plane types). Aircraft expend ammo then MUST rearm at afld/hpad; LOW power turns sam/agun off.

options.label: AA response
options.when: own AA thin (few flak/rocket units, no sam/agun)
options.play: move AA units under the flight path; queueBuildPlan sam/agun + ftrk or e3

options.label: disperse
options.play: split clumped squads and harvesters — strafes hit lines and clumps

options.label: kill the rearm cycle
options.when: enemy afld/hpad in knownEnemyStructures AND spare force
options.play: strike or airStrike the airfields

options.label: absorb + repair
options.play: hold; repair after the pass

entries.title: NAVAL THREAT
entries.facts: evidence: visibleEnemyCount/Value, targetType (ship types). CA/MSUB range 20c outranges every land defense (max 7.5c); destroyers carry AA; only ships or aircraft answer standoff bombardiers.

options.label: counter-navy
options.when: own shore access exists (S1.water) and funding healthy+
options.play: syrd/spen -> screen (dd or ss) -> engage the bombardiers

options.label: shore triage
options.when: buildings inside the shell line and no navy ready
options.play: sell doomed shore structures EARLY (refund is 50% x HP — it decays as they burn); move units out of the line

options.label: air answer
options.when: own strike aircraft exist AND escort AA is thin
options.play: airStrike the ships

entries.title: SUPERWEAPON (sighted or launched)
entries.facts: evidence: superweaponType (mslo/iron/pdox or launch order), status. Their 2000+ investment and timer is your window; low power pauses their timer too.

options.label: strike the silo
options.when: silo cell in knownEnemyStructures and a route exists
options.play: strike posture=assault onto the silo; targetPriority=any

options.label: race
options.when: your win condition is closer than their timer
options.play: push your plan; do not detour

options.label: mitigate
options.play: unclump army and production; keep cash for rebuild and repair

entries.title: HARVESTER THREATENED
entries.facts: evidence: assetId, hpPercent, visibleEnemyCount/Value, crushableAll, canDamageCount, underAttack, attackerClass. The ore truck crushes infantry; dogs deal ZERO damage to vehicles.

options.label: crush
options.play: order the harvester onto the attackers (move to their cell) — fleeing loses mining time it does not need to lose

options.label: flee (default reflex)
options.play: keep harvesterFlee=true and let the reflex dock it at the refinery

options.label: escort
options.play: guard 2-3 combat units onto the harvester; sweep the ore line

options.label: re-route
options.when: the contested line is far from defenses
options.play: move it to an alternate patch

entries.title: STRUCTURE DAMAGED
entries.facts: evidence: assetType, hpPercent, repairCostEstimate, sellRefundEstimate. Full repair costs ~20% of value; sell refunds 50% x current HP fraction.

options.label: repair
options.when: attacker gone or threat weak, AND cash > repairCostEstimate
options.play: repair — almost always right for production/power/refinery

options.label: sell
options.when: hpPercent < 25 AND threat strong AND no defenders in time
options.play: sell EARLY or not at all — the refund decays as it burns

options.label: ignore
options.play: spend the attention elsewhere

entries.title: ENEMY ECONOMY EXPOSED
entries.facts: evidence: targetType, visibleOnly=true. Absence of visible cover is NOT proof of safety — fog may hide defenders.

options.label: fast raid
options.when: route has no known defense line
options.play: strike posture=raid targetPriority=economy with FAST units (jeep/ftrk/1tnk/apc)

options.label: air raid
options.play: airStrike the exposed target

options.label: decline
options.play: note it in memo; opportunity windows reopen

entries.title: ENEMY RETREATING
entries.facts: mirrors the enemyRetreating alert (stable-cohort centroid recession).

options.label: pursue
options.when: you have a speed edge and no known defense line on the path
options.play: pursue mission (host leashes the chase)

options.label: release
options.play: repair, heal, reposition — do not feed a counter-ambush

options.label: counter-strike
options.when: their army is now out of position
options.play: strike the opposite flank or their economy

entries.title: SQUAD NEEDS REINFORCEMENT
entries.facts: mirrors the reinforcementNeeded alert (squad losing with reserves available).

options.label: reinforce
options.when: reserves exist and the fight is even/losing but winnable
options.play: reinforce mission toward the squad

options.label: withdraw
options.play: pull the squad to defenses/repair; regroup — NEVER trickle units in one at a time

options.label: sacrifice for tempo
options.when: the squad is buying time for a bigger play
options.play: accept the trade knowingly; state it in memo

entries.title: POWER LOW/CRITICAL
entries.facts: evidence: powerState. Low power: production ~3x slower, sam/agun/tsla and radar OFF, superweapon timers paused. Plant output scales with its damage.

options.label: build power now
options.play: next build = powr — cheapest and fastest fix; no exceptions under air threat (your AA is off)

options.label: income first
options.play: a power plant you cannot pay for never finishes — restore income first (harvester if you have fewer than refineries+1, else refinery) or sell/power-down excess drain; queue powr the moment it is affordable

options.label: repair plants first
options.play: repair (20% of value) beats rebuilding (100%)

options.label: shed load
options.play: sell or power-down a non-essential powered structure

entries.title: FUNDING STATE
entries.facts: evidence: funding bucket + funds. Buckets: broke < 500, reserve-only < 2000, healthy < 8000, floating-cash >= 8000.

options.label: broke
options.play: spend ONLY on income recovery: with fewer harvesters than refineries+1 a harvester is the exit, else the next refinery; protect harvesters (they ARE income); sell walls/fakes in extremis — waiting cures nothing

options.label: reserve-only
options.play: ONE queue only: economy or the active threat's counter; no tech detours

options.label: healthy
options.play: parallel queues; grow to 2 proc / 4+ harvesters, then take the next tech step

options.label: floating-cash
options.play: convert cash to capacity NOW: extra production building, second front, tech, or a superweapon (mslo) — when its timer completes, fire at their production or power cluster; idle cash plus idle queues is a strategy bug

entries.title: RECONNAISSANCE STALE
entries.facts: evidence: exploredPercent, activeSweepMissions. Most of the map is dark and nothing is scouting — an absent enemy is NOT an absent threat; every plan you make is a guess until you look.

options.label: sweep
options.when: you have any cheap fast unit (dog/jeep/e1)
options.play: assignGroup a scout pair and queueMission sweep — it explores continuously without costing further decisions

options.label: spy plane
options.when: soviet with the support power ready
options.play: spyPlane the quadrant where the enemy most likely lives (usually opposite your spawn)

options.label: accept blindness
options.play: state it in memo so the choice is deliberate, and scout immediately after

entries.title: WATER-ADJACENT BASE
entries.facts: evidence: waterAdjacent=true (static map context, not an alert).

options.label: naval second front
options.when: funding healthy+ AND the water plausibly reaches the enemy
options.play: syrd/spen -> screen ships -> bombardiers (CA/MSUB range 20c outranges all land defenses); scout the shore first

options.label: deny only
options.when: water is shared but funds are tight
options.play: pt/ss picket to deny their navy; skip bombardiers

options.label: ignore
options.when: landlocked pond or enemy unreachable by water
options.play: navy is a second front, not a rescue — spend on land
